description: A modern, minimalist coffee table with a rounded, light yellow frame and a dark wood-grained shelf. It features two black drawers with slim, silver handles, adding a sleek contrast to the natural wood tone. The table is supported by four angled, light wood legs, giving it a subtle mid-century modern feel. Its compact size and clean lines make it suitable for smaller living spaces or as an accent piece in larger rooms. The design balances functionality with a contemporary aesthetic, offering storage solutions without compromising on style. The overall look is clean, inviting, and versatile.
